_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The dev-prod-tabs flag adds a prod tab that links to exe.dev integration setup. The server runs in workspace mode with the "dev-prod-tabs" flag on, on a host without an exe.dev integration (as in CI): its VM list is empty, with the setup URL "https://exe.dev/integrations/add?service=exe-dev&attach=vm%3Ahost&source=shelley". On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Open the drawer. 3. Click the element with data-testid "nav-tab-prod". 4. The element with data-testid "assistant-row" should be visible (prod keeps the pinned Assistant above its VM list), with an href of exactly "/" and exactly 0 buttons inside it. 5. The link named "Set up an exe.dev integration" should have an href of exactly "https://exe.dev/integrations/add?service=exe-dev&attach=vm%3Ahost&source=shelley". 6. There must be exactly 0 elements with the text "No VMs.". 7. Click the element with data-testid "nav-tab-dev".
